The codeword enumerator was independently reproduced from all 128 possible words for each of 5040 column lists; a separate Fano enumerator verifies all 360 cycles and group orbits. Both tests finish and pass.

value.rationale: This is the complete coordinate-order optimization and pair-weight spectrum classification for the smallest perfect binary linear code in the pair-read metric: exactly two of thirty distinct indexed Hamming placements attain pair distance five, while the other twenty-eight attain four. It quantifies the attainable pair-read reliability/design choices rather than reciting ordinary Hamming bounds, a mere existence example, or an arbitrary subset of cases. The two distance-five codes attain the symbol-pair Singleton bound at size sixteen, making the placement distinction coding-theoretically sharp.
